history.summary: A brand-new, uncompleted (2034 TOP) 894 sqft 3BR at Vela Bay — first launch in the Bayshore precinct — directly beside Bayshore TEL station, asking $2,588 PSF, which is actually ~10% below the $2,863 project median. Exceptional connectivity and a master-planned 10,000-home waterfront catalyst make the location thesis strong, but the ~8-year build-out (heavy SSD/holding risk, no rental income for years), full new-launch pricing, and tight 894 sqft 3BR put it at Neutral for a 5-7yr investment hold.
history.rating_rationale: The location is genuinely first-class: 100m to Bayshore TEL station, the inaugural private launch in a master-planned 10,000-home car-lite waterfront precinct with future Long Island upside, in deep-buyer-pool D15. The ask of $2,588 PSF is ~10% under the $2,863 median, and the project sold 72% on launch day, signalling demand. But for an investment hold the timing is the problem: 2034 TOP means an ~8-year wait with no rental income, full BSD/ABSD capital tied up, and SSD exposure if the precinct re-rates and you want to exit early — the 5-7yr hold clock effectively doesn't start until completion. Pricing carries new-launch bias (no resale data exists), the $2,588 PSF is high in absolute terms for D15 leasehold, and 894 sqft is a compact 3BR. Strong asset, but the long dead-time and rich pricing balance the catalyst — Neutral.
red_flags: 2034 TOP — ~8-year build-out with no rental income; capital locked up and SSD/holding-period risk over the investment window
Full new-launch pricing (has_new_launch_bias true, no resale comps) at a high $2,588 PSF for D15 leasehold
Catalyst (Bayshore precinct/Long Island) is long-dated — payoff is back-loaded and partly speculative
catalysts: 100m to Bayshore TEL station — best connectivity in the batch; one-line ride to Marina Bay/Orchard
First mover in master-planned Bayshore precinct (~10,000 homes, car-lite, waterfront amenities, large SAFRA)
URA Long Island reclamation upside for the East Coast over the long run
Asking ~10% below project median PSF; 72% sold on launch day signals demand depth

agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: Not applicable for years — no rental income until ~2034 completion. On eventual completion, beside-MRT waterfront D15 should rent strongly to professionals/families, but that income is far in the future for a 5-7yr investment frame.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: Long-dated and back-loaded. Strong structural catalyst (precinct + Long Island + MRT-adjacency) but full launch pricing already prices in much of it; meaningful appreciation likely accrues post-2034, not within a near-term hold.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_rate_source: No URA resale data (new launch); CCR/RCR-fringe baseline given long build-out and launch-priced entry
